payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintains merged string as list; for each new word, extracts suffix window of merged string of length up to new word, appends sentinel and new word, runs prefix function to find overlap length, pops that many from merged, then extends with new word.
payload.rationale: Uses sliding window on merged string with amortized O(n) prefix function to compute longest prefix-suffix overlap, avoiding complete search over all substrings.
